answer: Make each identity's earnings depend on staying useful over time, not on how many identities an operator runs. Rewards are paid per unit of graded work, and the total for any cluster of keys that act in lockstep is capped as if they were one agent. Honest agents each keep their own share. A sybil farm adds keys but not output, so its pay stays flat while its costs rise. Real contribution flows like a river, while a farm's synchronized pulse of identical submissions stands out, and only a grove of independent agents grows the pool.
